title: objectql: the permission-set owner refusal envelope is built twice (body seam and residual registration)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① found by the contract review of PR #28153 (#28093, record 6525505738, should-fix #2) outside that PR's surface. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

## What the code does (read)

`permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` is module-private. PR #28153's residual registration in `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` shares the judge, one comparison as ADR-0086 D3 requires. But it rebuilds the refusal's `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 / `issues[]` envelope inline, because `engine.ts` was outside its surface (the hot file of #25522). The two envelopes can now drift.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

One envelope. Either export the helper, which is one word in `engine.ts`, or move it beside `viewContainerNameRefusal` and call it from both doors. This rides the next PR in `engine.ts`, after #25522's split.

## Dedupe

Read open titles for `permission set` + `refusal`, `permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal`: none. **New.**
